subject: Mathematics

curriculum_expectations.E2.1: identify measurable attributes of two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional objects, including length, area, mass, capacity, and angle
curriculum_expectations.E2.2: compare several everyday objects and order them according to length, area, mass, and capacity
curriculum_expectations.E2.3: read the date on a calendar, and use a calendar to identify days, weeks, months, holidays, and seasons

unit_overview: A 5-day Grade 1 unit on non-standard measurement (E2.1-E2.3) framed around 'How Long? How Big?' — Roo the Ruler Rabbit and Cal the Calendar Cat. Day 1 names measurable attributes (length, area, mass, capacity). Day 2 compares objects by length and area. Day 3 compares by mass and capacity, ordering 4+ objects. Day 4 reads a calendar (days, weeks, months). Day 5 closes with a Measurement Day Capstone integrating all 3 expectations. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
unit_learning_goal: Children will identify measurable attributes, compare and order objects by attributes, and read a calendar.

lesson_arc.big_idea: Every object has MEASURABLE ATTRIBUTES: length, area, mass, capacity.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can name measurable attributes of objects.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Roo introduces 4 attributes; children name attributes for everyday objects.

lesson_arc.big_idea: We line up to compare LENGTH. We cover to compare AREA.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can compare and order objects by length and area.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Roo lines up ribbons; children order by length and cover-compare area.

lesson_arc.big_idea: We use a balance for MASS. We pour for CAPACITY.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can compare and order objects by mass and capacity.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Children use a balance and pour to compare 4 objects by each attribute.

lesson_arc.big_idea: A CALENDAR shows DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, HOLIDAYS, and SEASONS.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can read the date and find days, weeks, months on a calendar.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Cal teaches calendar parts; children find dates, holidays, and seasons.

lesson_arc.big_idea: We name attributes, compare and order objects, and use a calendar to mark our measurement day.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can use measurement and the calendar together.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Children rotate through 4 stations: identify, compare, order, and calendar.

recurring_characters.name: Roo the Ruler Rabbit
recurring_characters.role: Lead character. A friendly rabbit who measures everything with a ruler. Anchors all 5 lessons.
recurring_characters.visual_description: A young rabbit holding a colourful ruler in one paw and a measuring tape in the other. Long ears, bright eyes.

recurring_characters.name: Cal the Calendar Cat
recurring_characters.role: Roo's partner. The 'time' character — keeps the calendar. Cameo Lessons 4-5.
recurring_characters.visual_description: A small striped cat with a tiny wall calendar slung over its shoulder. Holds a marker for crossing off dates.

threaded_vocabulary.child_friendly_definition: A way to describe an object — length, mass, etc.
How much space the FLAT shape covers.
A grid that shows days, weeks, and months.
A part of the year — spring, summer, fall, winter.

pedagogical_notes: Grade 1 measurement is concrete — handle real objects.
All 5 attributes must be NAMED, but only 4 are physically compared (angle is intro-only at G1).
Calendar reading uses TODAY'S date as anchor.
Connect calendar to weather (season) and Canadian holidays.
canadian_context_notes: Use Canadian holidays for calendar: Canada Day (July 1), Family Day (February), Thanksgiving (October).
Maple syrup season for spring discussion.
Hockey skate length for length comparison.
Tim Hortons cup sizes for capacity.
